responsibility: This implementation module realizes the gm2 assertion facility by testing a boolean condition, emitting a fixed failure message through StrIO, and halting the program when the condition is false. It is a small runtime diagnostic helper used by other library code to enforce internal invariants, distinct from the richer location-aware halt paths in Debug or M2RTS.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Assertion pair: unlike Assertion.def, which only declares Assert, this file performs the runtime check and on failure emits "assert failed - halting system" via StrIO before HALT.
